mode.title: Lead Mode
mode.description: Choose whether to pull newly registered active carriers (new_authorities), carriers facing pending authority revocation (pending_revocations), or look up specific USDOT numbers (usdot_lookup).

states.title: US States (2-letter codes)
states.description: Filter by physical/business state codes (e.g. TX, CA, FL, IL, GA). Leave empty to search nationwide.

daysBack.title: Days Back (New Authorities)
daysBack.description: For new_authorities mode: include active carriers added within the last N days.

maxPowerUnits.title: Max Power Units (Trucks)
maxPowerUnits.description: Optional maximum fleet size (e.g. 25 for owner-operators & small fleets).

authorizedForHireOnly.title: Authorized For-Hire Only
authorizedForHireOnly.description: Limit new_authorities results to Authorized For-Hire carriers (excludes private-only fleets).

requireContact.title: Require Phone or Email
requireContact.description: Skip leads that have neither a phone number nor an email address.

usdotNumbers.title: USDOT Numbers (Lookup Mode)
usdotNumbers.description: Specific USDOT numbers to enrich when mode is usdot_lookup.

maxLeads.title: Max Leads
maxLeads.description: Maximum leads to save in this run (1–1000).

onlyNew.title: Only New Leads (Delta Tracking)
onlyNew.description: Remember previously returned leadIds in a named Key-Value Store so daily schedules only emit brand-new leads.

trackingKey.title: Delta Tracking Key
trackingKey.description: Optional list key when onlyNew is enabled (e.g. tx-small-fleets).
